newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Innogenetics says Belgenetics no impact.
newsitem.headline: Innogenetics says Belgenetics no impact.

text.p: Easdaq-listed Belgian biotech company Innogenetics said on Friday it would not be affected by the liquidation of one of its shareholders, Belgenetics.

Panama-registered Belgenetics said in a statement in Belgian and Luxembourg newspapers that it planned to cease activities, awarding its shareholders 340 Innogenetics shares for each Belgenetics share they hold.
Innogenetics finance director Wim Ottevaere told Reuters, however, that the Innogenetic shares concerned already existed and there would be no impact on earnings.

"It's only a distribution of shares. There's no dilution...There are no consequences for Innogenetics," Ottevaere said. The two companies had nothing to do with each other, he stressed. "They are just a shareholder."

Officials at Fortis Bank Luxembourg, which is arranging an extraordinary meeting of Belgenetics shareholders in Luxembourg on February 6, were not immediately available to comment on how many Innogenetics shares were involved.
Separately, Ottevaere said Innogenetics would probably release provisional full-year 1996 results during the week starting January 27.
